# Methods

::: {.callout-note}
**Skeleton.** This chapter documents estimators S1-S6, the first-stage / manipulation check, robustness checks R1-R9, and known threats to validity (analysis plan §6-§9). No estimator code runs here; results chapters consume `results/estimates/`.
:::

## Estimators (planned)

| Spec | Method | Panel | Role |
|---|---|---|---|
| S1 | Event study (dynamic DiD) | A | Primary for RQ1 |
| S2 | Static TWFE DiD | A | CRZ vs control; border vs control |
| S3 | Cross-city synthetic control | B | Primary for systemwide RQ1 / RQ2 context |
| S4 | Within-NYC synthetic control | A aggregates | Lower bound under H3 spillovers |
| S5 | Synthetic DiD | A aggregates / B | Arkhangelsky et al. (2021) |
| S6 | Bayesian structural time series | Single series | First-stage and secondary outcomes |

### S1 - Event study (dynamic DiD)

Station and week fixed effects on Panel A with monthly `treated x relative-month` coefficients (reference = last pre-period relative month remaining after the DiD window cuts). Estimation sample starts at `did_pre_start` (2023-07-01), drops the washout, and ends at `post_end`. Primary specs include station-specific linear trends (§12); clustered SEs on `station_complex_id`. Treatment timing is uniform - all 66 CRZ stations are treated on 2025-01-05 - so there is no staggered adoption and the Goodman-Bacon negative-weighting critique of TWFE does not apply here.

### S2 - Static TWFE DiD

Same sample and FE structure as S1, with a single `treated x post` coefficient, run separately for CRZ vs control and border vs control. Primary specs include station-specific linear trends; the unadjusted TWFE is retained as robustness-only.

## Inference contract

Every estimator returns an `EstimateResult` (`src/cpca/estimators/base.py`) and serializes to `results/estimates/`. Point estimates are always reported with uncertainty intervals; specifications are not dropped for unwelcome signs.
